description: This script analyses documentation files to identify missing glossary entries in the i18n glossary JSON. It mainly reads and processes Markdown and MDX files to extract title and link label terms, compares them with a glossary JSON to find missing entries, and reports discrepancies.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for base and head git references.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command and returns its trimmed output.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Determines the git merge base or specified base for diff comparison.

methods.name: listChangedDocs
methods.description: Lists documentation files changed between two git refs.

methods.name: loadGlossarySources
methods.description: Loads the JSON glossary and returns a set of source terms.

methods.name: containsLatin
methods.description: Checks if a string contains Latin letters.

methods.name: unquoteScalar
methods.description: Removes quotes from a scalar string if present.

methods.name: isGlossaryCandidate
methods.description: Determines if a term qualifies as a glossary candidate based on length, language, and content.

methods.name: readGitFile
methods.description: Reads a file's content from a specific git base.

methods.name: extractTerms
methods.description: Extracts glossary terms from a file's text based on front-matter and list link syntax.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that drives the comparison and reporting process.
